title: Choose the visual world for brickbot.ro (bolder hand, round 3)
question: More depth, less self-praise: every card now leads with the people and the work, and results are evidence further down, never the headline. The deal put Brine Shelf first; Build Instructions beats it on both counts.

options.label: Brine Shelf
options.lineage: a fermentation calendar of jars on shelf lines
options.thesis: The team as batches left to mature: recruits, drive team, programmers, alumni, each jar labelled with when it started and how far it has come.
options.viewport: A dark shelf of glass jars glowing yellow at different levels, each labelled (Recruits · day 12, Alumni · day 3650), under the line 'Ten years of people, left to grow'.
options.risk: A food metaphor for a robotics team is a stretch; sponsors may not get it, and the robot disappears.

raised.raise: People first: faces cropped close and large, never small group thumbnails.
One identity spine runs through every page and carries across page transitions.

options.label: Build Instructions
options.lineage: brick build-instruction booklets, recast as exploded CAD on black
options.thesis: Brick by brick, literally: the page is an instruction book where each step adds a part of the robot and a part of the team.
materials: the new piece in yellow with a dashed arrow
options.viewport: A giant step numeral, then 'A robot every season. A team that builds people.' Beside it an isometric exploded robot assembly in grey keylines; this step's new part drops in yellow along a dashed arrow. A 1:1 call-out box sits in the corner.
options.case: Wins both counts: it is the brand line made literal, it shows the work instead of trophies, and the isometric parts give real depth.
options.risk: Instruction booklets come from toys. In black with CAD-grade line work it reads as engineering; done loosely, it reads as a kids' manual.

options.label: Safelight
options.lineage: a photo darkroom under safelight, the brand yellow as the light
options.thesis: The whole page bathes in brand yellow like a safelight, and the team's photographs develop out of the tray: every season develops someone.
options.viewport: A yellow screen. On the left, 'Every season develops someone.' On the right, a white tray where the Nationals photo develops from grey to black, with a grease-pencil note below it.
options.case: Very strong on people and impact, and bold with the yellow. Weaker on robotics: nothing says engineering.
options.risk: A drenched yellow page is intense to read at length; it needs dark sections to rest in.

options.label: Destination Blind
options.lineage: backlit bus destination blinds, cloth courses stepping under a window
options.thesis: The team as a vehicle going somewhere: yellow legends on dark cloth step through a window, from 'Focșani → the world' to the next stop.
options.viewport: A wide window of stacked cloth courses: a pale lead panel reads 'Focșani → the world', then 'Next: Romania Nationals', 'Join the crew' and 'Put your name on it', each a real link. They snap one course at a time.
options.case: Natively brand-yellow, about going places rather than about winning, and the courses are honest navigation. Less about people's faces.
options.risk: Transit signage can feel like a timetable; it needs photography alongside to stay human.

options.label: Endurance Garage
options.viewport: A striped body with a number roundel.
options.case: Declined: too close to the Race Livery you passed on, and its colours are off-brand.
options.kept: One identity spine across every page.

options.label: Scene Magazine
options.thesis: Hard-cropped flash portraits, scattered cover lines.
options.viewport: A cropped face under a hand-inked masthead.
options.case: Declined: fluorescent chaos fights the brand and reads as a fashion zine.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A dark team site with a yellow accent, built to the level of team254.com and citruscircuits.org.
canonCard.viewport: The team photo with a headline and two buttons, then the season, posts and sponsors.
canonCard.risk: Close to the removed first attempt; it looks like every other strong team's site.
